news.title: 3,000 flights cancelled as FAA ground stop chaos stretches into 2nd day
news.description: The chaos from the FAA's nationwide ground stop lingered into early Saturday morning, with thousands of flights cancelled as airlines played catch-up. Why it matters: Millions of travelers will find themselves inconvenienced over what the government says was simply old technology that couldn't keep up with modern upgrades. news.content: The chaos from the FAA's nationwide ground stop lingered into early Saturday morning, with thousands of flights cancelled as airlines played catch-up.Why it matters: Millions of travelers will find themselves inconvenienced over what the government says was simply old technology that couldn't keep up with modern upgrades. Driving the news: As of 5:15 a.m. ET Saturday, nearly 3,300 flights into, out of, or within the United States were already cancelled for the day, per FlightAware. Nearly 1,000 flights already had delays.Between the lines: The most heavily impacted airports were Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson, New York's JFK and Boston Logan. Among the major airlines, FlightAware's data showed Delta more affected than United or American. Zoom in: The ground stop wreaked havoc on college football in particular, with many schools unable to travel to their game locations.ESPN reported a number of high-profile match-ups were postponed to either late Saturday or Sunday as a result.What to watch: Whether Congress responds to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's request for $50 billion in emergency funding to modernize the nation's air traffic control system. This is a developing story. Check back for updates.

news.translatedDescription: 由于美国联邦航空局老旧空中交通管制通信系统发生严重过载故障，全美机场罕见实施地面停飞令，混乱态势已蔓延至第二天。全美已有逾3300架次航班取消，数百万周末出行旅客滞留机场，官员警告系统升级资金缺口巨大。
news.translatedContent:
美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）全国性停飞令所引发的空中交通大混乱持续蔓延至周六清晨。随着各家航空公司竭力调整班机与机组排班，全美各地已有数千架次航班被迫取消。

这场由老旧通信设备突发故障造成的空中停摆，给数百万计划在周末出行的旅客带来了严重不便。美交通运输部部长肖恩·达菲在新闻发布会上证实，通信故障源于过时的空中航路交通控制中心设备遭遇“严重数据超载并发生宕机”。

国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林补充指出，调查人员正在排查正在安装的新技术与数十年前老旧硬件之间的兼容性缺陷，目前没有迹象表明此次事故与敌对网络攻击有关。

达菲在白宫记者会上强烈呼吁国会批准更多空管基础设施现代化预算，并直言警告：“如果没有足够的专项资金，我们无法全面更新设备，未来类似的安全隐患与全国性停飞风险仍将重演。”

航空追踪网站FlightAware数据显示，截至美东时间周六清晨，进出及在美国境内执飞的航班已有近3300架次取消，超过1300架次延误，全美各大枢纽机场的运力恢复预计将持续至整个周末。

news.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
news.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
news.content:
The leaders of the US, Russia and China will meet late next week, according to the White House

Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said.

The historic meeting between the respective leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.

"The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said.

It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine. Moscow and Beijing have yet to comment.

No agreement was expected to follow the talks, an unnamed, senior US official said, according to news agencies AP and Reuters.

Trump will arrive in Shenzhen late on Wednesday for the two-day summit between the 21 member states. He will also take part in bilateral talks with Xi on Thursday - their fourth meeting since the US president returned to office in 2025.

"President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the president of the United States, the president of the People's Republic of China, and the president of the Russian Federation," Wales said.

She said Trump's trip, which will also include attending an Association of South-east Asian Nations (Asean) summit in the Philippines on Tuesday, would "secure historic wins to the American people and advance America's interests in the Indo Pacific".

A nuclear weapons control treaty between the US and Russia expired in February, leaving the world's biggest nuclear arsenals without major guardrails and effectively marking an end to the arms control co-operation that helped resolve the Cold War.

The UN has urged both sides to agree a new framework without delay. Trump however said he could replace the deal with a better agreement that included China, which has been building up its arsenal.

Former senior US officials and analysts told the BBC at the time that seeking Beijing and Moscow's co-operation could create major hurdles and take years.

Xi separately hosted both Putin and Trump in Beijing just days apart earlier this year, while the US president welcomed his Chinese counterpart to Washington in September.

Beijing has become a crucial trading partner for Moscow since it launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, which has isolated Russia and left it subject to Western sanctions.

But a controversial US deal to import Russian diesel and the suspension of sanctions targeting the biggest buyers of Moscow's oil and gas - including China - heightened European concern about the Trump administration's softening towards the Kremlin last month.

Trump and Xi have meanwhile sought to project warmer ties at summits in Beijing and Washington this year - though little significant progress appeared to have been made on key issues such as trade, their race for AI dominance, and Taiwan.

The war in Iran has also been a sticking point, with Beijing the largest buyer of Tehran's oil and its largest trade partner.

Chinese state media reported on Friday that Xi would take part in "bilateral" talks on the sidelines of the Apec summit, citing a foreign ministry spokesman, but has not reported on the trilateral meeting.

Earlier this month, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media that there were "signals confirming readiness" for such talks at the summit.

news.translatedDescription: 白宫发言人证实，特朗普、普京与习近平计划下周借多边峰会契机在中国举行历史性三方会晤。这是冷战以来美俄中三巨头首次同台正式对话，各方将聚焦核裁军与区域安全，但会晤筹备细节与具体议程仍在密集外交斡旋中。
news.translatedContent:
白宫新闻发言人正式向媒体证实，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与中国国家主席习近平计划于下周晚些时候在中国举行史无前例的三方首脑联合会晤。

白宫发言人卡罗琳·莱维特透露，此次会谈预计将在中国举行的多边峰会间隙进行。特朗普总统将在会谈中重点提出“共同削减核武器与遏制战略军备竞赛”的宏大和平倡议，寻求为长期陷入紧张的全球安全局势寻找突破口。

分析人士指出，若此次会晤如期举行，将成为现代地缘政治史上三大核大国最高领导人首次同台举行实质性三边会晤。然而，由于美中俄在乌克兰危机、高科技出口管制及印太防务部署上存在深刻分歧，三方外交工作团队目前仍在就具体日程与公报措辞进行闭门磋商。

news.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
news.description: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.
news.content:
Products such as Microsoft Teams and Outlook have been out of service for much of Friday

Microsoft has said its services have been fully restored after a worldwide outage affected several of its tools, causing disruption.

The tech firm said early on Saturday morning that efforts to address the underlying problem had been completed and customers using Outlook, Teams and Copilot should no longer be affected.

The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide.

Microsoft apologised for the technical issue, which it said was introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and was not caused by a cyber-attack or an artificial intelligence agent.

Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers.

Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday.

By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America.

Services were beginning to recover by Friday afternoon UK time, nearly 24 hours after the issues first began to emerge.

Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?

In the UK, some parts of the NHS were affected, as were some schools and police forces.

UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls and that there had been no disruption to the transport network.

In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails.

In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook.

Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday.

In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook.

The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals.

Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business had been effectively brought to a "standstill".

His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" had been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations".

Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she had been due to complete her first house purchase after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that.

"The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies," she said.

"We're not the only one completing today - there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible."

Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally.

It launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, but by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world.

By 13:32, the tech giant said there had been "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region.

Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remained stable once they were up and running again.

"We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said.

"We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously."

A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review.

Experts said that while workers may have been happy to not have email access for a working day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services.

"The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure.

Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem.

"Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said.

"In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur."

news.translatedDescription: 在经历长达一日的大规模全球网络瘫痪后，微软宣布Teams、Outlook及Copilot等核心云端平台已完全恢复正常运行。此次突发中断波及全球数以亿计的企业协作与医疗系统，微软承诺将全面排查基础设施根因以防重演。
news.translatedContent:
全球软件巨头微软于周六早间宣布，在历经数小时的紧急抢修与全网流量调度后，此前遭遇大面积瘫痪的核心企业级云服务已全面恢复正常运行。

周五白天，包括Microsoft Teams、Outlook电子邮箱以及AI助手Copilot在内的全线协同办公产品出现大范围掉线。根据网络状态监测平台DownDetector的数据，欧洲、亚洲和美洲各地上报的服务不可用报告瞬间突破数十万起，多国金融结算、跨国企业会议以及医疗机构门诊系统运转停滞。

微软在其官方云服务健康仪表板中表示：“我们已完成对底层网络配置与身份验证组件核心异常的彻底修复，目前所有核心指标均已回归健康基准线。”微软承诺将在未来几天内公布详细的事件根本原因分析（RCA）报告。

keyPoints: 微软核心办公套件与云端AI服务在长达数小时的中断后宣布完全恢复。
此次全球服务瘫痪造成广泛冲击，多国企业协同与医疗关键业务受挫。
微软技术团队已完成针对底层组件的修复，并启动系统性复盘调查。

news.title: Mississippi River cruise crash has no fatalities, critical injuries
news.description: Thirty-two people are in local hospitals and all passengers and crew are accounted for after a tanker collided with a Mississippi River cruise ship near the Port of New Orleans, officials said Friday. The big picture: With approximately 180 people on the ship, the rescue of all aboard is "truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno said at a press conference. What they're saying: While the investigation remains ongoing, officials said the Atlantic Asphalt tanker ap...
news.content: Thirty-two people are in local hospitals and all passengers and crew are accounted for after a tanker collided with a Mississippi River cruise ship near the Port of New Orleans, officials said Friday.The big picture: With approximately 180 people on the ship, the rescue of all aboard is "truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno said at a press conference.What they're saying: While the investigation remains ongoing, officials said the Atlantic Asphalt tanker appeared to have lost control, causing it to collide with the cruise ship. As passengers were disembarking after the collision, the cruise ship began to sink and eventually toppled over and flipped — leaving people in the cold water.The first 87 passengers got off while the ship was still afloat, Harbor Police Chief Melanie Montroll said. She added it "was normal conditions" on the river and that there wasn't a high current."I've never been prouder of a group of people than those people that came off of that boat," Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry said.Catch up quick: The American Heritage, a vessel operated by American Cruise Lines, had docked for passengers to disembark at the port Friday afternoon about two hours before it was hit, according to a press release from the Port of New Orleans.A city spokesman confirmed to Axios that the riverboat had rolled onto its side in the water, which social media videos appear to corroborate.Zoom out: The Atlantic Asphalt tanker is registered in the Marshall Islands, and had arrived at the Port of New Orleans on Nov. 11. Per data from myshiptracking.com, the tanker began its current journey in Paulsboro, New Jersey, in late October. Zoom in: The tanker was immobilized on the river Friday at about 2pm CT, with two tugs positioned on either side.Another dozen vessels were in the water nearby as a helicopter roamed overhead and sirens rang out over the water.Editor's note: This is a breaking news story and will be updated.

news.translatedContent:
当地时间周五下午，停靠在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良港的“美国遗产”号内河豪华游轮被一艘名为“大西洋沥青”号的重型散装货轮正面撞击，导致游轮发生严重倾斜并最终侧卧在密西西比河河道中。

新奥尔良市长海伦娜·莫雷诺在新闻发布会上证实，事故发生时游轮上载有约129名游客以及多名船员。在拖船船员、水上巡警和第一响应人员的舍生忘死营救下，船上所有人员在游轮彻底倾覆前全数撤离，实现了“零人员失踪”的生命奇迹。

港口医疗部门通报称，共有32名乘客因擦伤、呛水及骨折被送往周边医院接受治疗，目前所有人生命体征稳定。美国海岸警卫队初步勘验显示，撞船可能源于货轮舵机突发机械失控，联邦安全委员会已正式接管全案调查。

# US negotiators suggest Ukraine cedes territory in exchange for NATO membership

President Zelensky said the US had proposed ceding Ukraine's eastern city of Donbas to Russia, in exchange for Ukrainian membership of NATO, following the latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi this week. He reiterated that Kyiv was not willing to retreat from its territory and warned that the Kremlin's bid to change the continent's security architecture could lead to more wars.

Issued on: 14/11/2026 - 11:30

 1 min Reading time

Share

 By: 

FRANCE 24

 American special envoys Steve Witkoff (right) and Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump (left), with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Dublin, November 12, 2026. © Peter Morrison, AP Photo 

Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the United States proposed Ukraine cede land to Russia in exchange for joining NATO and that his government was in talks on "specific" security guarantees from the West.

He said that US negotiators had floated a question about Ukraine's potential withdrawal from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for ‌joining the alliance, following the ⁠latest round of peace talks with Russia in ‌Abu Dhabi.

Zelensky reiterated his position that ⁠Kyiv was not willing to retreat from its territory. He said that if Ukraine received a ‌comprehensive security package, that includes security guarantees, a strong and well-funded Ukrainian ‌army and funds to rebuild, he would put the question to a referendum.

"The Americans raised a question: "What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?" This was the first time this had been raised," Zelensky told reporters in remarks released by his office on Saturday.

He said the EU and NATO are Europe's only "real security", warning the Kremlin's bid to change the continent's security architecture could lead to more wars.

"This is dangerous because, in my view, it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations," Zelensky told reporters Friday in comments under embargo until Saturday. "Real security in Europe means the EU and NATO. That's it. There is no other security in Europe."

 'Big development' in peace talks as Ukraine says Europe to join Russia negotiations

news.translatedContent:
乌克兰总统泽连斯基在阿布扎比最新一轮和平谈判结束后向媒体公开发声，披露美方在磋商期间曾抛出一份妥协方案，提议乌克兰默认将东部顿巴斯地区实际控制权移交俄罗斯，以作为迅速接纳乌克兰加入北约的交换筹码。

泽连斯基对此予以断然拒绝，并重申基辅决不接受任何以出让国家领土完整为前提的不平等协议。他强调，宪法明确规定乌克兰领土不可分割，屈从于外部压力割让故土不仅无法带来持久和平，反而会彻底重塑欧洲二战以来的安全边界体系。

他进一步警告西方盟友，如果国际社会纵容通过军事侵略强行改变国际公认边界，不仅北约防卫公信力将荡然无存，未来整个欧亚大陆甚至全球其他热点地区都将面临连锁战争危机。

news.title: Can Nvidia survive without tech titan Jensen Huang?
news.description: The Financial Times says computing giant Nvidia has approached Rene Haas, CEO of British chip designer Arm, in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang. Huang resigned after his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Meanwhile some employees are clamouring for Huang's return – as his fellow tech leader Elon Musk. A sign of Huang's lingering star power, in an industry where so often the fate of each giant company depends on one man. Story by Peter O'Brien.

news.translatedContent:
英国《金融时报》报道披露，全球半导体算力巨头英伟达在创始人黄仁勋突发辞去首席执行官兼董事会主席职务后，已启动最高层紧急接班程序，并已向英国芯片架构设计龙头Arm的现任首席执行官雷内·哈斯发出了接洽意向。

黄仁勋执掌英伟达三十余年，凭借其非凡的战略洞察将公司打造为总市值达数万亿美元的AI算力底座。随着其因涉密丑闻黯然下台，硅谷与华尔街对这家芯片巨头未来的技术演进路线和市场统治力产生了普遍焦虑。

与此同时，包括特斯拉创始人马斯克在内的科技界多位重要人物以及英伟达部分内部员工纷纷公开发声，力挺黄仁勋重返帅位。这种罕见的声援不仅展现了黄仁勋在计算产业不可替代的个人威望，也暴露出高科技巨擘在脱离超级创始人后所面临的治理阵痛。

华盛顿政界正在对过去两年来高算力芯片如何经由中立国中转流向海外展开全方位审计，国会两党议员加紧要求对芯片出口豁免实施更严厉的问责制。这一事态给即将启程访问亚洲的美方高级代表团增添了极其复杂的外交包袱。

行业观察家指出，人工智能已被大国视为决定未来数十年经济竞争力与军事优势的核心支柱。在首脑峰会临近之际，如何在维护供应链现实利益与落实技术脱钩要求之间平衡，将成为考验各方战略定力的关键考题。

news.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
news.description: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.
news.content:
The lower stage of the rocket was diverted to the ocean as it burst into flames

SpaceX has aborted its attempt to catch the bottom part of its huge Starship rocket during its latest test flight.

The company had aimed to catch it using the mechanical arms - nicknamed chopsticks - on the launch tower as it returned to Earth, but instead it was diverted to the ocean, bursting into flames as it came down.

The top part of the rocket is now continuing its journey to space and SpaceX will decide whether it will try to catch this rocket stage at about 15:15 local time (21:15 GMT) on Saturday.

It is the aerospace firm's first attempt to fully recover its rocket, paving the way for making Starship fully reusable so it can fly repeatedly and reduce costs.

The 124m-tall (407ft) rocket successfully blasted off from the Starbase launchpad in Boca Chica, Texas at 16:45 local time on Friday.

The launch tower there was supposed to catch the bottom part of the rocket - the Super Heavy booster - six-and-a-half minutes later when it returned, but it was instead diverted to the ocean.

Starship is the tallest and most powerful rocket ever built

During a livestream of the launch, a SpaceX spokesperson said: "Safety is always the number one priority and we're still testing out things that we haven't done before on these vehicles, and so we are prioritising making sure that we can perform each manoeuvre safely."

The top part of the rocket, called the Ship, is continuing its journey to space, where it is deploying 26 satellites. These will form part of the Starlink constellation that provides high-speed internet.

The Ship is due to complete 14 orbits around the Earth before returning to the launch tower 22.5 hours after taking off, where a second catch may be attempted.

SpaceX has managed to catch the Super Heavy Booster on three earlier test flights.

But the upper stage of the rocket, which only reached orbit for the first time in September, has never been grabbed by the chopsticks.

Before the flight, SpaceX said it would only decide to try to catch the Ship after carefully assessing the vehicle while it was in space.

If any problems are detected, there are various points during the flight when the rocket stage can be brought down in the ocean.

A SpaceX lander could take astronauts down to the surface of the Moon

Building a fully reusable rocket is a long-held ambition for SpaceX.

In 2015, it became the first company to vertically land part of a rocket with its Falcon 9 booster.

Falcon 9 rockets now fly more than 100 times a year and the ability to reuse the bottom part of the rocket has dramatically cut the costs of launch.

But landing an entire Starship rocket could take this to the next level, says Prof Malcolm Macdonald, president of Royal Aeronautical Society.

"Full reusability has the potential to fundamentally change the economics of accessing space," he said.

"One successful flight will not prove that model, but it could mark an important transition: from demonstrating that Starship can fly, to demonstrating how Starship could operate."

After SpaceX became a public company earlier this year, its shareholders will be carefully monitoring this flight, as will Nasa.

The progress of Starship has direct implications for Nasa's attempt to land humans on the Moon in 2028 - a highly ambitious timeline.

What is Nasa's Artemis III mission? And what comes next?

Watch: From launch to fiery splashdown, SpaceX's Starship completes orbit test

SpaceX has been given a Nasa contract to configure the Ship into a lander that will eventually take astronauts down to the lunar surface.

But it is not the only company working with Nasa. Blue Origin, owned by rival tech billionaire Jeff Bezos, also has a contract to use its New Glenn rocket and lander for the Moon touchdown.

Both companies will also play a key role in the Artemis III mission, which is currently planned for summer 2027 - another challenging schedule.

Four astronauts in Nasa's Orion spacecraft will attempt to dock with both SpaceX and Blue Origin's landers during the voyage.

Starship will need to make a lot of progress in the coming months to meet these commitments - the pace of the rocket's development has been far slower than SpaceX had intended.

But Blue Origin also has much work to do. The company suffered a major setback earlier this year when its rocket exploded, totally destroying its launchpad in Florida.

Blue Origin had said its spacecraft would be back in action by the end of this year, but a return to flight has now been delayed to early in 2027.

Nasa is under pressure to meet its timelines. Its administrator Jared Isaacman has said the US was in a race with China to get to the Moon. China plans to land its Taikonauts on the lunar surface by 2030.

news.translatedContent:
美国太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）在其最新的星舰超重型火箭第十五次集成飞行测试中遭遇局部波折。由于下落阶段助推器尾部突发火情且遥测参数出现异常，地面控制团队在最后关头放弃了利用发射塔机械臂“筷子”在半空中捕获火箭主体的既定尝试。

在取消塔架捕获后，一级“超重型”助推器按照应急预案实施了入海受控机动，最终在墨西哥湾指定海域坠落并爆炸。SpaceX工程师表示，中止机制的触发恰恰体现了自动化安全冗余系统的可靠性，有效保护了造价昂贵的地面发射基础设施。

令人欣慰的是，星舰上层飞船在与助推器顺利分离后，成功点燃六台猛禽发动机并顺利进入亚轨道滑行路径，继续完成了太空舱重返大气层的热防护与气动控制试验。

keyPoints: SpaceX中止星舰超重助推器发射塔回收尝试，助推器在起火后坠海。
地面控制系统因未达安全边界触发中止指令，避免了对发射基础设施造成损坏。
星舰飞船本体成功进入预定测试轨道，为后续迭代提供关键飞行遥测数据。

news.title: Goalkeeper given 12-game ban for fatal collision with Tenerife striker
news.description: Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.
news.content:
Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

[CBC World (加拿大广播公司) 补充报道]: While Spain mourns the death of a soccer player who suffered a cardiac arrest after an on-field collision, the emergency medical treatment he received is falling under scrutiny.

news.translatedTitle: 西班牙足坛撞击致死悲剧后续 安道尔门将遭重罚禁赛十二场
news.summary: 安道尔足球俱乐部门将奥沃诺因在西乙比赛中与特内里费前锋德米格尔发生剧烈碰撞致后者心脏骤停离世，被正式处以禁赛12场的严厉纪律处罚。这起球场悲剧在西班牙体坛引发持续哀悼，同时也引发关于赛场紧急医疗救护流程的深度反思。
news.fullText:
Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.



While Spain mourns the death of a soccer player who suffered a cardiac arrest after an on-field collision, the emergency medical treatment he received is falling under scrutiny.

news.translatedDescription: 安道尔足球俱乐部门将奥沃诺因在西乙比赛中与特内里费前锋德米格尔发生剧烈碰撞致后者心脏骤停离世，被正式处以禁赛12场的严厉纪律处罚。这起球场悲剧在西班牙体坛引发持续哀悼，同时也引发关于赛场紧急医疗救护流程的深度反思。
news.translatedContent:
在经历了一场震惊欧洲体坛的球场碰撞惨剧后，西班牙皇家足球协会纪律委员会于周六正式宣布，对安道尔队门将赫苏斯·奥沃诺处以长达12场的禁赛处罚。

在日前进行的一场西乙职业联赛焦点战中，奥沃诺在一次出击拦截高空球时与特内里费队主力前锋赫苏斯·德米格尔发生惨烈冲撞。德米格尔倒地后突发创伤性心脏骤停，尽管现场医护人员全力抢救并送医，仍因伤势过重不幸宣告不治，年仅27岁。

## New French protests focus on children and police

 People are expected to take to the streets for the fifth Saturday in a row, with a main rally in Paris and dozens of other gatherings across the country.In the capital, the Yellow Vest movement is joining high-school students, unions and other activists fighting for children's rights or opposed to a bill to give police more protection in their use of weapons. 

Le Monde with AFP

Published today at 10:20 am (Paris)
1 min read

French high school and university students, teachers and national education staff protest to demand better school conditions, in Paris, France, November 10, 2026. ABDUL SABOOR / REUTERS

France faces more rallies on Saturday, November 14, with demonstrators venting frustrations ranging from inflation to opposition to a new police bill at the latest protests. The European Union's second-largest economy has been gripped by high-school blockades and cost-of-living demonstrations for more than a month, ahead of presidential elections next year that the far right sees as its best chance of seizing power.

Some of the largely peaceful rallies have seen fringe violence, as well as accusations of police brutality. People are to take to the streets for the fifth Saturday in a row, with a main rally in Paris from 1 pm local time and dozens of other gatherings across the country. In the capital, the Yellow Vest movement is expected to join high-school students, unions and other activists fighting for children's rights or opposed to a bill to give police more protection in their use of weapons.

Activists have in recent months demanded better protection for children against sexual abuse. Others will be protesting against a new bill in Parliament to grant police who use their weapons a presumption of legitimate self-defense. Backers, including the far-right Rassemblement National party of presidential hopeful Marine Le Pen, say it is necessary to avoid police being automatically suspected of using disproportionate force.

## 'Licence to kill'

Activists argue the bill, approved by the lower house and soon to go to the Sénat, amounts to a "licence to kill." They say it would make holding security forces accountable even harder in a country where most cases of alleged police brutality rarely reach a criminal court.

Lawyers last week denounced alleged police violence at recent protests that led to "mutilations," including hand, foot and eye injuries. Around 146,000 people took part in demonstrations across France on Saturday last week, according to authorities, far lower numbers than on previous weekends.

The largest protests in recent weeks occurred during a union-led strike on Thursday last week, when more than half a million people took to the streets nationwide, according to official figures. Unions have called for a new day of strikes on Tuesday, after rejecting a government promise to increase the minimum wage by 0.6% as "crumbs."

Le Monde with AFP

news.translatedContent:
法国《世界报》报道，周六，法国全境迎来了民众因反对物价飞涨与争议法案而发起的连续第五个周末全国大抗议。除巴黎的数万人主力游行外，全国各地还同步举行了数十场集会与路障封锁行动。

在首都巴黎，这场抗议展现出不同维权力量深度融合的新特征：重返街头的“黄背心”基层抗议者与多家中学生工会、教师联合会并肩游行。示威的核心诉求集中于抵制议会正在审议的一项备受争议的安全新法案——该草案拟在执法行动中进一步放宽防暴警察使用枪械与非致命性致残武器的免责门槛。

人权观察机构与学生家长协会在现场发表联合联合宣言，强烈指责内政部近期对未成年高中生的强硬逮捕与警棍殴打行径已越过文明法治红线，要求政府立即撤回争议草案并对多起警暴滥权事件启动全面独立司法调查。

news.description: The arrest comes just a week after Tokyo and Washington agreed to measures aimed at preventing crimes by US service members on the island after a murder allegedly involving an American Marine triggered outrage.
news.content:
TOKYO: Japanese police arrested a United States Air Force captain Saturday (Nov 14) on suspicion of drunk driving in Okinawa, a police spokesman said, in the latest twist to strains between the Pacific allies.

The arrest comes just a week after Tokyo and Washington agreed to measures aimed at preventing crimes by US service members on the island of Okinawa after a murder allegedly involving an American marine triggered outrage.

The US military has around 54,000 personnel stationed in Japan, mostly on Okinawa. Crimes committed by its members have been a thorn in relations between the close security allies.

US officials also said last week they would extend a curfew to lower-ranking service members through Dec 7, while banning all service members from drinking alcohol outside their homes between midnight and 5am.

Police arrested the 27-year-old as he "was driving on a road in Okinawa City at around 3.09am Saturday," a spokesman for Okinawa prefectural police told AFP.

"It is not clear if he violated the curfew" imposed by US officials, he said.

The arrested captain was assigned to Kadena Air Base on Okinawa, Kyodo News reported.

Officials at the base were not immediately available for comment.

source.name: Channel News Asia (新加坡亚洲新闻台)

news.translatedContent:
日本冲绳县警方发言人证实，当地执法部门于周六清晨在首府那霸市巡逻时，依法逮捕了一名隶属于美军嘉手纳基地的现役空军上尉，理由是其涉嫌严重酒后危险驾驶。

这一丑闻让刚刚稍显缓和的美日防务外交关系再度蒙上阴影。仅仅一周前，东京与华盛顿外交与防务高官才刚刚达成一系列旨在严整驻军纪律、建立联合巡查的补充安全协定，旨在平息数月前一名美军士兵涉及恶性恶性案件在冲绳全岛激起的强烈民愤。

news.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins flips Alaska’s gubernatorial seat
news.description: It’s the first time Alaskans have elected a Democrat to the corner office in over two decades.
news.content: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has defeated a trio of Republicans to flip Alaska’s open gubernatorial seat.Kreiss-Tomkins, a millennial former state lawmaker, will succeed term-limited Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy. It’s the first time Alaskans have elected a Democrat to the corner office in over two decades. And Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, will be the youngest governor in the state’s history.National groups plowed millions of dollars into the four-way, all-party race. Democrats benefited from a fractured GOP field that President Donald Trump failed to whittle by endorsing Bernadette Wilson.
news.author: By Lisa Kashinsky

relatedSources.name: NBC News (美国全国广播公司)
relatedSources.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins the Alaska governor’s race

news.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status
news.description: An international health organization has determined that the United States has lost its measles elimination status, according to multiple news reports. Why it matters: It's an official recognition of how much the country's public health has deteriorated due to a rolling series of outbreaks since early last year. Increased public skepticism about the safety and effectiveness of vaccines, a barrage of distrust from federal officials like Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and funding cuts f...
news.content: An international health organization has determined that the United States has lost its measles elimination status, according to multiple news reports.Why it matters: It's an official recognition of how much the country's public health has deteriorated due to a rolling series of outbreaks since early last year.Increased public skepticism about the safety and effectiveness of vaccines, a barrage of distrust from federal officials like Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and funding cuts for response efforts have all factored in the surge of cases, according to public health experts.The big picture: The Pan American Health Organization concluded there has been sustained transmission of the highly contagious virus for longer than 12 months, bringing the U.S. case count to its highest level in 35 years.The measles elimination status hinges on whether the same strain of measles stays in circulation for 12 months or longer without a break.The overwhelming majority of cases are in unvaccinated people. While overall measles vaccination rates remain relatively high, public health officials say they have to remain above 95% to maintain herd immunity.Driving the news: An expert panel convened by the Pan American Health Organization made the widely expected decision following a three-day meeting in Washington, D.C.What they're saying: "It is no surprise that the resurgence of measles has coincided with an administration that has inflicted significant damage to our health care system while spreading false claims about vaccines," said Richard Besser, president and CEO of the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation and a former acting director of the Centers for Disease Control."It is unthinkable that people in the United States should be dying from measles in 2026," the Infectious Diseases Society said in comments prior to the decision.The group cited the potential long-term toll on infants infected this year, some of whom could develop serious neurologic disease years after the initial infection.By the numbers: There have been 5,412 confirmed cases so far this year, compared to 2,289 for all of 2025, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's latest tally. The last time measles cases were higher was in 1991, when the U.S. had 9,643 cases.Pennsylvania is in the grip of an outbreak that has accounted for more than 1,500 cases so far and six measles-associated deaths. news.translatedContent:
多家国际权威媒体证实，世界卫生组织（WHO）及泛美卫生组织已正式撤销美国的麻疹“本土消除”认证地位。这一具有里程碑意义的倒退，正式标志着美国维持了二十余年的公共卫生重要防线宣告破裂。

根据美国疾控中心数据，自去年初以来，美国多个州爆发了持续蔓延超过12个月的本土连环麻疹疫情。流行病学调查显示，公众对常规疫苗安全性的怀疑情绪在近年来大幅上升，部分社区适龄儿童的麻腮风三联疫苗（MMR）接种率已跌破维持群体免疫所需的95%关键警戒线。

包括新任卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪在内的部分联邦高官多次在公开场合对主流医学界的疫苗共识提出异议，加之联邦及州级公共卫生追踪预算遭受大幅削减，使得疾控专家对未来可能暴发的更多可预防传染病危机表达了极度忧虑。

news.title: From Gen X to Gen Z, ‘unicorn game’ GTA VI’s multigenerational pull is a threat to Hollywood’s holiday blockbusters
news.description: Thirteen years after GTA V, GTA VI arrives with more than $1 billion in sales already booked and a gaming calendar cleared for it.
news.content: Thirteen years after its predecessor, Grand Theft Auto VI finally arrives on Nov. 19. The sixth installment in Rockstar Games’ open-world crime series launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, and its pull is likely to be felt well beyond gaming, wherever other entertainment competes for the same audience’s time. When Grand Theft Auto V came out in 2013, it generated $800 million in sales in its first 24 hours. It has since sold nearly 235 million units, according to parent company Take-Two Interactive’s latest earnings release. The new game is on pace to crush those numbers. Sensor Tower estimates GTA VI had logged about 12.1 million digital preorders worth roughly $1.18 billion as of the morning of Nov. 13. If it were a movie, GTA VI would already be one of the year’s top-grossing films. Its preorders alone top the roughly $1.01 billion that The Super Mario Galaxy Movie has grossed worldwide, according to The Numbers’ 2026 worldwide box office chart. The stakes for Take-Two are enormous. Analysts estimate the publisher has spent $1 billion to $1.5 billion on the game, as Fortune has reported on CEO Strauss Zelnick’s bet. Earlier this month, Take-Two held its forecast of $8 billion to $8.2 billion in net bookings for the fiscal year ending in March, saying preorders were running well ahead of its expectations. news.translatedDescription: 在历经长达十三年的等待后，《侠盗猎车手6》将于11月19日正式登陆次世代主机，其预订销售额已突破十亿美元大关。业界分析指出，这部跨越X世代至Z世代的现象级数字娱乐作品，将在年底假期档严重分流传统好莱坞院线票房。
news.translatedContent:
《财富》杂志商业观察指出，距前作《GTA V》惊艳问世整整13年后，Rockstar旗下的划时代开放世界动作冒险巨构《侠盗猎车手6》（GTA VI）定于11月19日在PS5与Xbox Series平台全球首发。在游戏尚未正式交付之际，全球预订销售总额已惊人地突破10亿美元。

这部被业内誉为“独角兽级”的超级文娱作品不仅吸引着伴随系列成长的X世代与千禧一代老玩家，更在Z世代年轻人中掀起狂热讨论。为了避免被其空前的话语权碾压，多家全球知名游戏发行商均主动调整了自家年终大作的发售档期。

好莱坞大型制片厂的高管们同样严阵以待。分析师警告称，在即将到来的感恩节与圣诞节假期档，数千万核心消费群体将沉浸于虚拟罪恶都市的互动体验中，这对原本就面临流媒体与观影人次萎缩的好莱坞院线大片形成了致命的注意力掠夺。

news.title: NYC is spending $70 million on 5 city-run grocery stores that will price essentials 30% below retail
news.description: Five stores, one in each borough, are unlikely to substantially change grocery prices in a city with nearly 1,000 supermarkets and more than 8 million inhabitants.
news.content: New York City is moving closer to launching its effort to counter food inflation by opening five city-run grocery stores. Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced in May 2026 that the first store would open in the Hunts Point neighborhood of the South Bronx in 2027, with another in East Harlem to follow. Five stores, one in each borough, are unlikely to substantially change grocery prices in a city with nearly 1,000 supermarkets and more than 8 million inhabitants. But each could make a meaningful difference to the grocery bills of local shoppers by selling essentials at below-market prices. Even with just five planned stores set to open in lower-income neighborhoods, the initiative has ignited fierce opposition from independent grocers, supermarket trade associations and a coalition representing immigrant-owned food businesses. What explains this pushback? As a food policy scholar, I believe this opposition is about more than the immediate economic impact of five stores. It is about the precedent they could establish. Mamdani’s initiative challenges an entrenched expectation that the government should leave the provision of consumer goods to private enterprise even as it encourages businesses to invest in certain locations, regulates their activities and helps low-income shoppers through various food assistance programs. The reality is more complicated. For at least a century, New York’s food economy has not operated independently of government. In fact, public policies and investments have long shaped where supermarkets open, which businesses can operate with a profit, and how residents obtain food. It’s just that they have done so in ways consumers often don’t see. That is why the five grocery stores carry a broader significance, in my view. They offer a different model of public investment that makes the government much more visible in providing an essential service – and more accountable for its results. New Yorkers will get an opportunity to judge that contribution directly. If the stores succeed, they may change not just what people expect to pay for groceries, but what they expect their city government to provide. How the plan will work New York City has committed US$70 million to develop these stores, which will be open to all. While they will be managed by private operators, the city will provide rent-free space, prioritize publicly owned sites and ensure that essential foods are priced 30% below typical retail prices. news.translatedDescription: 为缓解持续高企的食品通胀压力，纽约市政府推进斥资7000万美元在五大行政区设立市营公立平价超市的试点计划。首批门店将以低于市场零售价30%的水平向市民提供基本生活食品，但舆论质疑少量门店对庞大城市物价整体影响有限。
news.translatedContent:
《财富》杂志报道，面临广大中低收入家庭因物价飞涨而日益加剧的生存压力，纽约市政府正在加速落实一项前所未有的市政干预举措：直接拨付7000万美元公共资金，在全市五个行政区分别打造一家由政府直接运营的平价公立超市。

纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼公布的规划显示，首家市政超市定于2027年在南布朗克斯贫困街区率先落成，随后将在东哈莱姆等地跟进。这些公立超市将由政府集中直采并免除商业房租利润成本，承诺以低于普通连锁商业超市近30%的优惠价格销售新鲜果蔬、肉类与奶制品等民生主食。

然而，这一市政实验在经济学界和零售行业引发了激烈争论。批评人士指出，对于一个拥有超过800万常住人口、近千家大中型商业超市的大都会而言，区区五家公办门店无法从根本上改变城市的食品价格曲线，且可能因官僚管理效率低下而演化为财政补贴黑洞。

news.title: Meet ‘Captain Keel,’ the 37-year-old steering a Bitcoin miner into the AI data center gold rush
news.description: Ben Gagnon is turning Bitfarms into Keel Infrastructure, swapping crypto for the one thing AI giants can’t get enough of: power.
news.content: In late 2023, Bitcoin miner Ben Gagnon concluded that his employer, Bitfarms of Quebec, was in the wrong business. For Gagnon, Bitfarms’ greatest value lay not in the giant racks of GPUs that generated Bitcoin, but the immense power supplies it controlled. The then 34-year-old chief mining officer who’d launched his career crafting makeshift crypto-minting rigs in Hong Kong and Taipei, reckoned that Bitfarms could make much more money by exiting the field full stop, demolishing the “mines,” selling the chips that filled them, and re-channeling its plentiful flow of megawatts to power-craving industrial users at plants newly built on the Bitfarms sites. The big revelation came in March of 2024, when Core Scientific and CoreWeave unveiled a stunning new deal. Bitcoin titan Core Scientific would refashion a mining facility in Austin, Texas, as an AI data center, and rent the power and buildings to the neocloud. That Bitcoin-to-AI play struck Gagnon as a model that Bitfarms could follow on a grand scale, from Quebec to Washington state. “It was the big aha moment,” recalls Gagnon. “Suddenly, we saw who the right customer was.” At the time, Bitfarms was mired in turmoil. In early 2024, the board was searching for its third leader in five years. The sitting chief agreed to depart when Bitfarms named a successor, but in May—believe it or not while still CEO—instead filed a $27 million suit for “wrongful termination and breach of contract,” plunging this Canadian exemplar of all-green, hydro-driven Bitcoin mining into legal warfare. Pounded by a sharp drop in the token’s prices, Bitfarms’ stock was languishing, and a rival pounced. Two days after the board fired the CEO, Riot Platforms unveiled a hostile $930 million takeover bid for Bitfarms at a lowly $2.30 a share, 75% below its peak in late 2021. After Bitfarms installed a “poison pill” defense, Riot launched a website dubbed “A Better Bitfarms” trashing allegedly poor corporate governance, and demanding the departure of the co-founder named as interim chief. The board tapped Gagnon to both quell the war versus Riot, and pursue the strategy of total transformation he’d been advocating. In July of 2024, Gagnon took the helm, and over the next few months, helped broker an agreement where Riot named a director of its choice, and the co-founder left the board. After Bitfarms installed a “poison pill” defense, Riot launched a website dubbed “A Better Bitfarms” trashing allegedly poor corporate governance, and demanding the departure of the co-founder named as interim chief. The board tapped Gagnon to both quell the war versus Riot, and pursue the strategy of total transformation he’d been advocating. In July of 2024, Gagnon took the helm, and over the next few months, helped broker an agreement where Riot named a director of its choice, and the co-founder left the board. news.title: Jensen Huang’s $145 billion question: What California divorce law says Lori Huang could get
news.description: Lori Huang could be entitled to half the couple's community property under California law. Most of Jensen Huang's 870 million Nvidia shares sit in trusts they share.
news.content: Jensen Huang has lost his job, his board seat, and roughly $10 billion in paper wealth since admitting to an affair. If his 41-year marriage ends, California law could put a far larger share of his fortune in play. Huang stepped down as Nvidia’s president, CEO, and director this week, days after confessing in a letter to Nvidia employees that he had been unfaithful to Lori Huang, his wife since 1985. The board named chief financial officer Colette Kress Nvidia’s interim CEO and made longtime director Harvey Jones its first board chair while it searches for a permanent successor. “I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Huang wrote. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” The admission followed a New York Times report that U.S. intelligence agencies suspected Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed, of gathering information for Beijing, and that she had a close relationship with Huang. China has denied involvement. Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said this week that she left Singapore in February and was barred from returning after a police investigation, which it said “did not concern espionage.” Two more relationships have since been reported. The New York Times reported on November 11 that Huang had been romantically involved with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, who reported directly to him, citing five people who had worked at the company. A day later, Reuters reported that Huang had an intimate relationship with another Nvidia employee, whom it did not name. Powell did not respond to the Times, and Nvidia declined to comment to Reuters. Nvidia’s board opened an independent investigation into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort and said it had “no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.” An FBI inquiry into his relationship with Alice Huang is also underway. Huang has not announced plans to divorce. But a split would test how California divides a fortune built almost entirely on a single stock, and the answer would turn less on his headline net worth than on how the couple’s Nvidia shares were acquired and held. news.translatedDescription: 在因桃色丑闻辞去英伟达职务并损失上百亿美元账面财富后，黄仁勋可能面临更为严峻的离婚财产分割。依据加利福尼亚州夫妻共同财产法律原则，结婚41年的妻子有权获得半数资产，涉及两人共同信托中持有的数亿股英伟达巨额股票。
news.translatedContent:
《财富》杂志法律专题指出，在因承认婚外不当关系被迫辞去英伟达总裁兼CEO职务后，黄仁勋所面临的财富清算可能才刚刚开始。若其长达41年的婚姻最终破裂走向法庭，加利福尼亚州严苛的财产清算法律将让其天量财富面临腰斩。

根据加州特有的“夫妻共同财产”（Community Property）法律体系，除非签署了极为明确的婚前协议，否则夫妻在婚姻关系存续期间积累的所有股权与商业资产均归双方平分。资料显示，黄仁勋家族持有的绝大部分英伟达资产（超过8.7亿股股票）均登记在二人共同设立的家族信托之下。

婚姻家庭法律专家分析称，如果其配偶洛里·黄正式启动离婚诉讼，将诞生人类商业史上规模最大的夫妻财产分割案之一，涉案总值高达近1450亿美元。未来如果涉及大宗股权转让或减持变现，英伟达的股权架构稳定性与治理话语权恐将遭遇剧烈震荡。

news.translatedContent:
美联社发自柬埔寨金边的电讯报道，两年一度的法语国家组织（OIF）首脑峰会于周六正式拉开帷幕。法国总统马克龙在顶着国内严峻社会抗议的巨大压力下亲自率团出席，试图利用该多边平台稳固法国在亚洲与非洲的软实力纽带。

然而，此次峰会的氛围被非洲大陆多起激化的地缘军事危机所笼罩。刚果（金）东部的血腥武装冲突、卢旺达受到的跨境干涉指责以及西非萨赫勒多国爆发军人政变后的疏离，使得原本主打文化与经贸合作的集团内部陷入前所未有的路线分裂。

部分非洲国家代表对西方主导的多边调停机制表现出明显的厌倦与抵触。马克龙在开幕致辞中呼吁各成员国摒弃零和博弈，通过多边人道走廊与青年教育投资化解危机，但各方能否就最终公报达成实质共识仍充满未知数。

news.title: Pressure grows on Trump's Commerce Secretary Lutnick in fallout from Nvidia scandal
news.description: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".
news.content:
How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security?

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has blamed Howard Lutnick's Commerce Department for failing to properly oversee the export of high-spec AI chips, as the fallout from the Nvidia scandal widens to President Donald Trump's cabinet.

Pressure is building on Lutnick from across the political spectrum to explain his department's actions.

Jensen Huang was ousted as Nvidia CEO after revelations he had an affair with a businesswoman who was also allegedly a Chinese spy.

Megaspeed, the firm she worked for, had been probed by US government agencies over suspicions it was smuggling Nvidia chips into China, reports said, but was not on a list of firms US companies are prevented from working with.

Bessent told CNBC several agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".

"But Commerce has the pen... and you will have to ask them about their internal process," he added.

Bessent's comments come after Lutnick was called to testify before the Senate Banking Committee next month over the Commerce Department's role in allowing Nvidia to export its advanced chips.

Other congressional committees have asked both Lutnick and his department to retain all records relating to Nvidia and Huang.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said some parts of the administration wanted more controls on trade with Megaspeed

Bessent said he was "frustrated" by delays in putting the company on the export control list and reports of leakage of AI chips into China.

"President Trump made it very clear that China should not receive any Nvidia chips above H100s, so any leakage is very frustrating because it hurts our great companies in the AI race, because it gives the Chinese an advantage," he said.

Last year, the Commerce Department had been investigating Megaspeed over suspicions it had been smuggling some of Nvidia's advanced AI chips into China, according to the New York Times. Megaspeed has been contacted for comment.

There was also pressure on the Commerce Department to add it to the list, but the Financial Times separately reported that the department was delaying efforts to have the cloud computing firm included.

However, Bessent also pointed the finger at Nvidia.

"The story has been thus far of Jensen Huang's personal foibles," he told CNBC, external.

"The real story here should be: did Nvidia know their client, and was there a robust effort at Nvidia to make sure that there was no leakage and that they were selling to what were obviously pass-through shell companies?

"It's important that anyone at the company there be held accountable for that."

Bessent's pointed comments are a rare instance of internal debate within the Trump administration spilling out into the public view, although tensions have reportedly simmered between Bessent and Lutnick in the past.

In 2024, the two reportedly jostled for the role of treasury secretary ahead of Trump's return to the White House, and last year the pair butted heads over the administration's tariff policy, according to US media.

How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House

How AI visionary Jensen Huang was undone by his own bad decisions

Huang has been summoned to testify before the Senate Banking Committee about his alleged affair with the former Megaspeed executive, who is suspected of being a Chinese spy.

The commerce secretary has also been summoned to appear before the committee in December.

"Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology," committee chairman Republican Senator Tim Scott posted on X.

Democrats on key congressional committees have asked the Commerce Department and Lutnick to keep all records relating to decisions to allow Nvidia to sell its advanced AI chips to Chinese companies, including all their communications with or about Nvidia and Huang.

Ways and Means Committee Ranking Member Richard E Neal and Senate Finance Committee Ranking Member Ron Wyden are starting investigations into the way Nvidia was allowed to sell these chips.

They say Nvidia's advanced H200 chips could be sold to Chinese firms if they were first imported from their manufacturing facility in Taiwan into the US for inspection.

A 25% tariff - a levy paid by US importers to the federal government - was imposed on those chips under a section of the Trade Act that Neal and Wyden say is meant to allow the US president to take action against imports that risk national security.

"Trump's use of the statute appears to have done the opposite, undermining US national security and putting Americans at risk," they said.

Megaspeed, the firm she worked for, had been probed by US government agencies over suspicions it was smuggling Nvidia chips into China, reports said, but was not on a list of firms US companies are prevented from working with.

Bessent told CNBC several agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".

"But Commerce has the pen... and you will have to ask them about their internal process," he added.

Bessent's comments come after Lutnick was called to testify before the Senate Banking Committee next month over the Commerce Department's role in allowing Nvidia to export its advanced chips.

Other congressional committees have asked both Lutnick and his department to retain all records relating to Nvidia and Huang.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said some parts of the administration wanted more controls on trade with Megaspeed

Bessent said he was "frustrated" by delays in putting the company on the export control list and reports of leakage of AI chips into China.

"President Trump made it very clear that China should not receive any Nvidia chips above H100s, so any leakage is very frustrating because it hurts our great companies in the AI race, because it gives the Chinese an advantage," he said.

Last year, the Commerce Department had been investigating Megaspeed over suspicions it had been smuggling some of Nvidia's advanced AI chips into China, according to the New York Times. Megaspeed has been contacted for comment.

There was also pressure on the Commerce Department to add it to the list, but the Financial Times separately reported that the department was delaying efforts to have the cloud computing firm included.

However, Bessent also pointed the finger at Nvidia.

"The story has been thus far of Jensen Huang's personal foibles," he told CNBC, external.

"The real story here should be: did Nvidia know their client, and was there a robust effort at Nvidia to make sure that there was no leakage and that they were selling to what were obviously pass-through shell companies?

"It's important that anyone at the company there be held accountable for that."

Bessent's pointed comments are a rare instance of internal debate within the Trump administration spilling out into the public view, although tensions have reportedly simmered between Bessent and Lutnick in the past.

In 2024, the two reportedly jostled for the role of treasury secretary ahead of Trump's return to the White House, and last year the pair butted heads over the administration's tariff policy, according to US media.

How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House

How AI visionary Jensen Huang was undone by his own bad decisions

Huang has been summoned to testify before the Senate Banking Committee about his alleged affair with the former Megaspeed executive, who is suspected of being a Chinese spy.

The commerce secretary has also been summoned to appear before the committee in December.

"Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology," committee chairman Republican Senator Tim Scott posted on X.

Democrats on key congressional committees have asked the Commerce Department and Lutnick to keep all records relating to decisions to allow Nvidia to sell its advanced AI chips to Chinese companies, including all their communications with or about Nvidia and Huang.

Ways and Means Committee Ranking Member Richard E Neal and Senate Finance Committee Ranking Member Ron Wyden are starting investigations into the way Nvidia was allowed to sell these chips.

They say Nvidia's advanced H200 chips could be sold to Chinese firms if they were first imported from their manufacturing facility in Taiwan into the US for inspection.

A 25% tariff - a levy paid by US importers to the federal government - was imposed on those chips under a section of the Trade Act that Neal and Wyden say is meant to allow the US president to take action against imports that risk national security.

"Trump's use of the statute appears to have done the opposite, undermining US national security and putting Americans at risk," they said.

news.translatedDescription: 随着英伟达前CEO涉华丑闻不断外溢，特朗普内阁内部爆发问责风暴。美财长贝森特公开指责商务部长卢特尼克领导的部门对尖端AI芯片出口监管存在严重疏漏，未能及时将违规转口中介列入实体清单，两党议员纷纷要求启动国会听证。
news.translatedContent:
BBC商业频道报道，围绕英伟达前高管丑闻发酵引发的次生政治海啸正在全面席卷华盛顿内阁核心圈。美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在接受CNBC专访时公开将矛头指向商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，严厉指责其所属的工业与安全局（BIS）在芯片出口合规审查中出现灾难性漏洞。

贝森特直言不讳地指出，包括财政部在内的多个联邦执法与情报机构早在数月前就已掌握确凿线索，多次正式敦促商务部将涉嫌违规转口英伟达高算力GPU的关键中介公司Megaspeed列入制裁实体清单，但商务部却因官僚拖延迟迟未予立案惩处。

这一公开指责彻底引爆了特朗普内阁团队内部的职能矛盾。参众两院跨党派国家安全委员会已紧急发出传票，要求商务部与财政部主要负责人下周前往国会山接受公开质询，全面厘清高科技出口防线是否存在监管失察或利益输送。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》报道，香港特区政府运输署于周六发表正式官方声明，就近日在移动即时通讯软件WhatsApp上广泛流传的虚假“丰田车辆安全气囊召回通知”向广大市民发出严正防诈骗警示。

运输署发言人指出，这批伪造的中文短讯赫然带有“运输署”字样和官方公函徽标，声称车主所持有的丰田汽车存在致命气囊隐患需即时更换，并附带恶意钓鱼网址，诱骗受害人输入车牌号、香港身份证号码及银行账户详情。运输署明确澄清，绝不会通过短信或聊天软件直接向个别车主发送索要隐私信息的召回通知。

目前，运输署已将该起有组织网络电信诈骗案移交香港警务处网络安全及科技罪案调查科跟进侦办。特区政府呼吁市民提高警惕，如对车辆召回真伪存疑，应直接致电各品牌特约代理商或查阅运输署官方门户网站确认。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》刊发深度文化特稿，向国际读者系统介绍了中国古代民间源远流长的“冲喜”婚俗传统。在传统农业社会，当家族长辈或直系亲属罹患沉疴、久治不愈时，家族往往会急促张罗并提前举办婚嫁喜宴，试图借助欢庆氛围来“克制”病邪与凶兆。

历史学者与社会学家分析认为，在现代科学医学诞生前，“冲喜”本质上是一种深层次的群体心理防御机制。通过将家庭注意力从疾病死亡的恐惧焦虑，迅速转移至象征生命繁衍与新开端的红喜事上，极大激发了病患的生存意志，并在宗族内部完成了财富与社会资源的再动员。

尽管在当代科学文明视域下，“冲喜”已被视作蒙昧迷信的旧俗而逐渐淡出历史舞台，但在人类学视野中，它依然是透视东方传统农耕社会生死观、阴阳互补哲学以及宗族伦理凝聚力的重要文化活化石。

尽管在当代科学文明视域下，“冲喜”已被视作蒙昧迷信的旧俗而逐渐淡出历史舞台，但在人类学视野中，它依然是透视东方传统农耕社会生死观、阴阳互补哲学以及宗族伦理凝聚力的重要文化活化石。
keyPoints: 外媒深入探寻中国古代通过婚嫁喜事驱除疾患与逆境的“冲喜”民俗流变。
传统社会在缺乏现代医学条件下，通过集体庆典仪式转移焦虑并凝聚宗族支持。
民俗学家指出该现象生动反映了东方文化中阴阳调和与生命转换的朴素哲学。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》援引发表在权威学术期刊《亚洲男科学杂志》（Asian Journal of Andrology）上的最新临床研究成果指出，由中国多所顶尖医学院校联合开展的一项涵盖2.6万名成年男性的流行病学调查发现，男士贴身衣物的款式选择对其生理健康有着超出以往认知的决定性影响。

研究数据表明，与习惯穿着宽松透气平角四角短裤（Boxers）的对照组相比，长期穿着紧绷合身三角内裤（Briefs）的受试者，其患上勃起功能障碍（ED）、早泄以及慢性前列腺炎的概率呈现出统计学上的显著上升。同时，长期压迫与局部散热不良还会直接削弱精子活动力与精子浓度指标。

男科与泌尿外科专家指出，男性生殖器官对温度极度敏感，过紧的衣物会紧贴体表使阴囊区域长时间处于高于正常生理基准的温度下，同时阻碍盆腔微循环静脉回流。医疗专家呼吁广大男性应从日常着装习惯入手，优先选择天然棉质、剪裁宽松的平角裤以维系生理系统微生态平衡。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》报道，香港警务处处长周一鸣在出席警察学院结业典礼后正式宣布，警队将于下周一全面在覆盖全港的智慧闭路电视（CCTV）监控网络中启用人工智能人脸识别辅助侦查系统。

周一鸣处长向媒体强调，引入的人工智能深度学习算法经过严格的实战测试，具备极高的空间几何比对与特征还原精度。即使涉嫌违法的犯罪嫌疑人佩戴口罩、墨镜或采取其他伪装手段试图逃避侦测，系统仍能通过局部特征与骨骼步态分析实现精准识别。

他义正词严地向潜在违法者发出警示：“无论犯罪分子采取何种反侦查手段，只要触犯法律，香港警队都有绝对的科技能力与执法决心将其绳之以法。”警方同时重申，新技术的所有数据流与调用权限均严格置于香港现行法律与个人资料隐私条例的严密监管之下。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》报道，针对香港私人屋苑长期存在的大厦大额翻新工程“围标”分赃以及滥用纸质授权书操纵业主大会的治理顽疾，香港特区政府民政及青年事务局局长麦美娟于周六正式公布了多项标本兼治的重大改革措施。

麦美娟表示，特区政府将于明年正式推出一套基于官方数字身份认证的“电子委任代表投票平台”试点计划。长期以来，不法中介与工程利益集团往往利用长者业主疏于防范，大量收集并伪造空白纸质授权书，强行在业主立案法团大会上通过天价大修工程预算。电子化实名平台将彻底粉碎这一灰色利益链条。

此次针对《建筑物管理条例》的全面重构，是在近一年前大埔私人住宅发生导致严重死伤的火灾事故后，特区政府强力推动的民生制度善政。政府将通过试点收集运行数据，为未来立法强制设定个人可持有代理票数上限扫清技术障碍。

news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》发表深度产业观察文章指出，中国国家能源局日前正式就《中华人民共和国可再生能源法（修订草案征求意见稿）》面向全社会公开征集意见，征求意见期将持续至12月5日。这标志着支撑中国过去二十年完成波澜壮阔的绿色工业跃升的顶层法律框架正迎来重大时代更新。

回顾二十年前，刚刚加入世贸组织的中国能源消费激增，而正是《可再生能源法》的确立与施行，催生了举世瞩目的新能源全产业链集群。如今，中国制造的光伏组件与大型风电装备占据了全球市场份额的大半壁江山，以极具竞争力的平价技术大幅拉低了全球清洁转型的单位度电成本。

国际知名能源经济学者在文中建议，在中国加快构建新型电力系统与大容量储能法治保障的同时，中国应当更加主动地通过多边平台与“一带一路”绿色倡议，向急需低碳转型的全球南方国家成套共享电网调度管理、分布式能源接入及绿色融资等成熟规制经验。

news.translatedDescription: 旨在保护覆盖全球近三分之二公海海域生态的《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性条约》（BBNJ）生效近一年，但观察家警告该机制正沦为大国地缘博弈新战场。中国已正式批准该条约，而美俄等大国至今尚未加入，令深海环保治理面临重大不确定性。
news.translatedContent:
《南华早报》报道，被联合国誉为自《联合国海洋法公约》以来最重要海洋保护多边公约的《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性条约》（简称《公海条约》或BBNJ）生效即将届满一周年。然而，来自全球各地的海洋治理观察家近日纷纷发出严正警告，这一里程碑式的生态保护协议正面临被大国地缘政治对抗窒息的巨大风险。

公约管辖的公海海域占据了地球海洋表面积的近三分之二，对维持全球气候稳定与生物基因库具有不可替代的价值。目前全球已有包括中国在内的105个主权国家正式完成了批准程序，为设立跨国公海海洋保护区奠定了法理基石。然而，美国和俄罗斯两大关键海洋强国至今仍未批准该条约，使得条约的普遍代表性与执法效力受到结构性制约。

围绕公海深海海底矿产资源开采配额、海洋遗传资源开发收益的惠益分享机制，发达国家与广大发展中国家之间的争吵正在显著加剧。学者警告，如果大国将多边环保协议工具化为限制地缘对手的博弈杠杆，全球拯救脆弱公海生态系统的历史性窗口期恐将稍纵即逝。

news.translatedContent:
美联社发自华盛顿的报道披露，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已决定在下周启程出访菲律宾与中国的重大外访行程中，将全球首富兼SpaceX与特斯拉掌门人埃隆·马斯克纳入其最高级别核心随行顾问团。

作为同时深耕商业航天火箭、电动汽车智造以及前沿人工智能赛道的商业巨擘，马斯克旗下的产业在亚太地区拥有极其庞大的商业市场版图与供应链纵深。特别是在中美科技与经贸关系处于十字路口的背景下，其作为特朗普核心政策幕僚的地位无疑将进一步凸显。

然而，白宫高级筹备官员在背景简报会上明确透露，面对近期在硅谷与华盛顿政界持续震荡的英伟达前CEO涉华技术违规调查风波，美方官方代表团计划在整个外访期间刻意回避并降温此类极具争议性的半导体管控话题，以确保在更广泛的经贸谈判与大国地缘安全议题上取得可见成果。

news.translatedContent:
知名科技媒体The Verge援引路透社独家披露的文件报道，全球电子商务巨头亚马逊正在全力秘密搭建一个庞大的数据基础设施库，内部项目代号为“全球商品图谱”（World Product Graph）。该项目的野心在于系统性抓取并结构化索引全互联网范围内售卖的每一件消费品信息，即便这些商品并未在其官方电商平台陈列销售。

亚马逊的这项战略防御举措，直接剑指日益改变网络消费行为的生成式AI搜索与垂直社区。长期以来，海量网购消费者在最终做出购买决策前，习惯于流连在谷歌搜索、Reddit论坛或短视频平台查阅第三方客观测评与比价。亚马逊希望通过收编全网商业知识图谱，让用户无论检索任何冷门或竞品信息，都能始终停留在亚马逊的生态闭环之内。

更深远的布局还在于即将全面普及的自主型AI购物代理（AI Agents）。亚马逊高管深知，谁掌握了全球最完备、更新最实时的商品元数据索引，谁就能成为未来全网AI智能体下单采买的唯一入口与底层结算枢纽。

法国24台体育快讯报道，在巴黎法兰西体育场爆满的八万名狂热主场球迷见证下，法国国家男子橄榄球队（蓝衣军团）在一场窒息般惨烈的鏖战中，以21比19的微弱优势力克两届世界冠军得主南非“跳羚队”（Springboks）。

这场史诗级的胜利彻底终结了法国队在长达21年时间里未能于巴黎主场击败南非队的尴尬历史。比赛进入伤停补时的终局阶段，南非队展开了排山倒海般的高压反扑，但由世界级球星安托万·杜邦统领的法国防线众志成城，凭借钢铁般的身体对抗硬生生瓦解了对手在达阵线前的最后一次强突尝试。

凭借这场含金量十足的硬仗胜利，法国蓝衣军团不仅一扫此前国内体育舆论的阴霾，更顺利斩获了通往伦敦特威克纳姆体育场参加首届国际国家锦标赛（Nations Championship）巅峰总决赛的关键入场券。

news.title: France's school principals say threats and violence have become unbearable
news.description: Headteachers gathered across France this Friday, to demonstrate their frustration after nearly two months of student protests that have blockaded high schools. Many of the teachers support the students, but say they feel exhausted and isolated as the violence has surged. They are calling the government to protect them. Story by Vedika Bahl.

news.translatedTitle: 法国全国中学校长发起抗议 痛陈校园暴力与威胁激增已不堪重负
news.summary: 全法国数百名公立中学校长与高级教职人员在各大城市集会请愿，表达对长达两个月的学生罢课封校与校园暴力浪潮的强烈抗议。校长们表示，尽管理解年轻人对未来的焦虑，但教职员工日常遭受的暴力威胁已超出承受极限，敦促国民教育部提供安全庇护。

news.translatedDescription: 全法国数百名公立中学校长与高级教职人员在各大城市集会请愿，表达对长达两个月的学生罢课封校与校园暴力浪潮的强烈抗议。校长们表示，尽管理解年轻人对未来的焦虑，但教职员工日常遭受的暴力威胁已超出承受极限，敦促国民教育部提供安全庇护。
news.translatedContent:
法国24台社会纪实报道，本周五，来自法国各省公立初级与高级中学的数百名校长代表破天荒地在巴黎及多座首府城市走上街头举行维权集会，痛陈长达近两个月的持续性学生抗议封校行动，已将法国中等教育体系的基层管理者推向身心崩溃的悬崖边缘。

自秋季学期以来，伴随着社会整体反通胀与反警暴示威的蔓延，大量未成年高中生受社交媒体激化，在校园大门设置燃烧路障、阻挠师生入校，甚至对试图维持正常教学秩序的教职管理人员发起言语辱骂与实体暴力袭击。校长们在集会发言中强调，他们并非不支持青少年的公民表达权利，但目前校园内蔓延的极端化倾向已经彻底剥夺了师生的人身安全底线。

校长工会组织向国民教育部递交了联名请愿书，严厉敦促中央政府不能再将校园暴力作为孤立的治安个案推诿给基层，必须即刻向面临暴力高危风险的学区派驻专业安保与心理干预常驻团队，重塑宁静庄严的校园治学环境。

allEnhancedNews.title: 3,000 flights cancelled as FAA ground stop chaos stretches into 2nd day
allEnhancedNews.description: The chaos from the FAA's nationwide ground stop lingered into early Saturday morning, with thousands of flights cancelled as airlines played catch-up. Why it matters: Millions of travelers will find themselves inconvenienced over what the government says was simply old technology that couldn't keep up with modern upgrades. Driving the news: As of 5:15 a.m. ET Saturday, nearly 3,300 flights into, out of, or within the United States were already cancelled for the day, per FlightAware. Nearly 1,...
allEnhancedNews.content: The chaos from the FAA's nationwide ground stop lingered into early Saturday morning, with thousands of flights cancelled as airlines played catch-up.Why it matters: Millions of travelers will find themselves inconvenienced over what the government says was simply old technology that couldn't keep up with modern upgrades. Driving the news: As of 5:15 a.m. ET Saturday, nearly 3,300 flights into, out of, or within the United States were already cancelled for the day, per FlightAware. Nearly 1,000 flights already had delays.Between the lines: The most heavily impacted airports were Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson, New York's JFK and Boston Logan. Among the major airlines, FlightAware's data showed Delta more affected than United or American. Zoom in: The ground stop wreaked havoc on college football in particular, with many schools unable to travel to their game locations.ESPN reported a number of high-profile match-ups were postponed to either late Saturday or Sunday as a result.What to watch: Whether Congress responds to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's request for $50 billion in emergency funding to modernize the nation's air traffic control system. This is a developing story. Check back for updates.

allEnhancedNews.translatedDescription: 由于美国联邦航空局老旧空中交通管制通信系统发生严重过载故障，全美机场罕见实施地面停飞令，混乱态势已蔓延至第二天。全美已有逾3300架次航班取消，数百万周末出行旅客滞留机场，官员警告系统升级资金缺口巨大。
allEnhancedNews.translatedContent:
美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）全国性停飞令所引发的空中交通大混乱持续蔓延至周六清晨。随着各家航空公司竭力调整班机与机组排班，全美各地已有数千架次航班被迫取消。

这场由老旧通信设备突发故障造成的空中停摆，给数百万计划在周末出行的旅客带来了严重不便。美交通运输部部长肖恩·达菲在新闻发布会上证实，通信故障源于过时的空中航路交通控制中心设备遭遇“严重数据超载并发生宕机”。

国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林补充指出，调查人员正在排查正在安装的新技术与数十年前老旧硬件之间的兼容性缺陷，目前没有迹象表明此次事故与敌对网络攻击有关。

达菲在白宫记者会上强烈呼吁国会批准更多空管基础设施现代化预算，并直言警告：“如果没有足够的专项资金，我们无法全面更新设备，未来类似的安全隐患与全国性停飞风险仍将重演。”

航空追踪网站FlightAware数据显示，截至美东时间周六清晨，进出及在美国境内执飞的航班已有近3300架次取消，超过1300架次延误，全美各大枢纽机场的运力恢复预计将持续至整个周末。

全美单日已有超过3300架次航班被迫取消，机场航线秩序严重受阻。
美交通部长强调非网络攻击，但警告缺乏国会升级资金类似事故或重演。

allEnhancedNews.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
allEnhancedNews.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
allEnhancedNews.content:
The leaders of the US, Russia and China will meet late next week, according to the White House

Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said.

The historic meeting between the respective leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.

"The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said.

It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine. Moscow and Beijing have yet to comment.

No agreement was expected to follow the talks, an unnamed, senior US official said, according to news agencies AP and Reuters.

Trump will arrive in Shenzhen late on Wednesday for the two-day summit between the 21 member states. He will also take part in bilateral talks with Xi on Thursday - their fourth meeting since the US president returned to office in 2025.

"President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the president of the United States, the president of the People's Republic of China, and the president of the Russian Federation," Wales said.

She said Trump's trip, which will also include attending an Association of South-east Asian Nations (Asean) summit in the Philippines on Tuesday, would "secure historic wins to the American people and advance America's interests in the Indo Pacific".

A nuclear weapons control treaty between the US and Russia expired in February, leaving the world's biggest nuclear arsenals without major guardrails and effectively marking an end to the arms control co-operation that helped resolve the Cold War.

The UN has urged both sides to agree a new framework without delay. Trump however said he could replace the deal with a better agreement that included China, which has been building up its arsenal.

Former senior US officials and analysts told the BBC at the time that seeking Beijing and Moscow's co-operation could create major hurdles and take years.

Xi separately hosted both Putin and Trump in Beijing just days apart earlier this year, while the US president welcomed his Chinese counterpart to Washington in September.

Beijing has become a crucial trading partner for Moscow since it launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, which has isolated Russia and left it subject to Western sanctions.

But a controversial US deal to import Russian diesel and the suspension of sanctions targeting the biggest buyers of Moscow's oil and gas - including China - heightened European concern about the Trump administration's softening towards the Kremlin last month.

Trump and Xi have meanwhile sought to project warmer ties at summits in Beijing and Washington this year - though little significant progress appeared to have been made on key issues such as trade, their race for AI dominance, and Taiwan.

The war in Iran has also been a sticking point, with Beijing the largest buyer of Tehran's oil and its largest trade partner.

Chinese state media reported on Friday that Xi would take part in "bilateral" talks on the sidelines of the Apec summit, citing a foreign ministry spokesman, but has not reported on the trilateral meeting.

Earlier this month, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media that there were "signals confirming readiness" for such talks at the summit.

Xi separately hosted both Putin and Trump in Beijing just days apart earlier this year, while the US president welcomed his Chinese counterpart to Washington in September.

Beijing has become a crucial trading partner for Moscow since it launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, which has isolated Russia and left it subject to Western sanctions.

Trump and Xi have meanwhile sought to project warmer ties at summits in Beijing and Washington this year - though little significant progress appeared to have been made on key issues such as trade, their race for AI dominance, and Taiwan.

The war in Iran has also been a sticking point, with Beijing the largest buyer of Tehran's oil and its largest trade partner.

Chinese state media reported on Friday that Xi would take part in "bilateral" talks on the sidelines of the Apec summit, citing a foreign ministry spokesman, but has not reported on the trilateral meeting.

Earlier this month, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media that there were "signals confirming readiness" for such talks at the summit.

What really holds China and Russia together

allEnhancedNews.translatedContent:
白宫新闻发言人正式向媒体证实，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与中国国家主席习近平计划于下周晚些时候在中国举行史无前例的三方首脑联合会晤。

白宫发言人卡罗琳·莱维特透露，此次会谈预计将在中国举行的多边峰会间隙进行。特朗普总统将在会谈中重点提出“共同削减核武器与遏制战略军备竞赛”的宏大和平倡议，寻求为长期陷入紧张的全球安全局势寻找突破口。

分析人士指出，若此次会晤如期举行，将成为现代地缘政治史上三大核大国最高领导人首次同台举行实质性三边会晤。然而，由于美中俄在乌克兰危机、高科技出口管制及印太防务部署上存在深刻分歧，三方外交工作团队目前仍在就具体日程与公报措辞进行闭门磋商。

allEnhancedNews.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
allEnhancedNews.description: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.
allEnhancedNews.content:
Products such as Microsoft Teams and Outlook have been out of service for much of Friday

Microsoft has said its services have been fully restored after a worldwide outage affected several of its tools, causing disruption.

The tech firm said early on Saturday morning that efforts to address the underlying problem had been completed and customers using Outlook, Teams and Copilot should no longer be affected.

The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide.

Microsoft apologised for the technical issue, which it said was introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and was not caused by a cyber-attack or an artificial intelligence agent.

Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers.

Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday.

By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America.

Services were beginning to recover by Friday afternoon UK time, nearly 24 hours after the issues first began to emerge.

Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?

Courts, spies and MPs: How the Microsoft outage has been felt around the world

In the UK, some parts of the NHS were affected, as were some schools and police forces.

UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls and that there had been no disruption to the transport network.

In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails.

In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook.

Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday.

In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook.

The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals.

Pete says his business has been brought to a standstill

Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business had been effectively brought to a "standstill".

His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" had been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations".

Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she had been due to complete her first house purchase after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that.

"The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies," she said.

"We're not the only one completing today - there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible."

Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally.

It launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, but by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world.

By 13:32, the tech giant said there had been "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region.

Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remained stable once they were up and running again.

"We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said.

"We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously."

A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review.

Experts said that while workers may have been happy to not have email access for a working day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services.

"The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure.

Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem.

"Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said.

"In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur."

allEnhancedNews.description: Thirty-two people are in local hospitals and all passengers and crew are accounted for after a tanker collided with a Mississippi River cruise ship near the Port of New Orleans, officials said Friday. allEnhancedNews.content: Thirty-two people are in local hospitals and all passengers and crew are accounted for after a tanker collided with a Mississippi River cruise ship near the Port of New Orleans, officials said Friday.The big picture: With approximately 180 people on the ship, the rescue of all aboard is "truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno said at a press conference.What they're saying: While the investigation remains ongoing, officials said the Atlantic Asphalt tanker appeared to have lost control, causing it to collide with the cruise ship. As passengers were disembarking after the collision, the cruise ship began to sink and eventually toppled over and flipped — leaving people in the cold water.The first 87 passengers got off while the ship was still afloat, Harbor Police Chief Melanie Montroll said. She added it "was normal conditions" on the river and that there wasn't a high current."I've never been prouder of a group of people than those people that came off of that boat," Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry said.Catch up quick: The American Heritage, a vessel operated by American Cruise Lines, had docked for passengers to disembark at the port Friday afternoon about two hours before it was hit, according to a press release from the Port of New Orleans.A city spokesman confirmed to Axios that the riverboat had rolled onto its side in the water, which social media videos appear to corroborate.Zoom out: The Atlantic Asphalt tanker is registered in the Marshall Islands, and had arrived at the Port of New Orleans on Nov. 11. Per data from myshiptracking.com, the tanker began its current journey in Paulsboro, New Jersey, in late October. Zoom in: The tanker was immobilized on the river Friday at about 2pm CT, with two tugs positioned on either side.Another dozen vessels were in the water nearby as a helicopter roamed overhead and sirens rang out over the water.Editor's note: This is a breaking news story and will be updated.

allEnhancedNews.translatedContent:
当地时间周五下午，停靠在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良港的“美国遗产”号内河豪华游轮被一艘名为“大西洋沥青”号的重型散装货轮正面撞击，导致游轮发生严重倾斜并最终侧卧在密西西比河河道中。

新奥尔良市长海伦娜·莫雷诺在新闻发布会上证实，事故发生时游轮上载有约129名游客以及多名船员。在拖船船员、水上巡警和第一响应人员的舍生忘死营救下，船上所有人员在游轮彻底倾覆前全数撤离，实现了“零人员失踪”的生命奇迹。

港口医疗部门通报称，共有32名乘客因擦伤、呛水及骨折被送往周边医院接受治疗，目前所有人生命体征稳定。美国海岸警卫队初步勘验显示，撞船可能源于货轮舵机突发机械失控，联邦安全委员会已正式接管全案调查。
